name: web/SQLi error-based MSSQL-family
description: [high] Proves error-based SQLi on the Microsoft SQL Server family: broken quote returns Unclosed quotation mark / Conversion failed / System.Data.SqlClient.SqlException / Microsoft OLE DB Provider for SQL Server = T-SQL interpretation (often exposes column/type context for UNION follow-up). Keywords: sqli error-based mssql sqlserver t-sql sqlexception injection. ctrl: benign POST shows no driver error -> not falsified. probe_url = JSON endpoint echoing 'q'.

conditions.pattern: Unclosed quotation mark after the character string|Conversion failed when converting|System\.Data\.SqlClient\.SqlException|Microsoft OLE DB Provider for SQL Server
